name: makeup-look-planner
description: Build a look board and pack the right products.

interface.longDescription: Build a look board and pack the right products. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Arrange finish and shade choices; Build a makeup packing checklist; Compare your swatch notes. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me arrange finish and shade choices.
Help me build a makeup packing checklist.

prompts: Help me arrange finish and shade choices.
Help me build a makeup packing checklist.
Help me compare your swatch notes.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Finish & Shade: Makeup workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Arrange finish and shade choices. Reproducible inputs: {"occasion":"Evening dinner","steps":[{"area":"base","product":"Tint","shade":"Medium neutral","finish":"satin","minutes":5},{"area":"lips","product":"Lip color","shade":"Berry","finish":"matte","minutes":2}]}

positive.expected_behavior: Uses makeup_look_planner_look_board with the supplied inputs. Returns {"occasion":"Evening dinner","steps":[{"area":"base","product":"Tint","shade":"Medium neutral","finish":"satin","minutes":5},{"area":"lips","product":"Lip color","shade":"Berry","finish":"matte","minutes":2}],"total_minutes":7,"areas_covered":["base","lips"]}.
